reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: After freezing, started again with the UvA dated curriculum diagram, study table, choice page and the current workbook rows. Rechecked underlying teaching content, year sequence, term cells, prerequisite order and proposed positive pairings before comparing them with the frozen record.
findings: UvA’s regular Dutch-language full-time Biology bachelor (RIO 56860) totals 180 EC. The first year builds from cells, genetics, microbes and data to animals, plants, ecology and the sustainability policy project. The second year connects cellular responses, immunity, neurobiology and evolution with quantitative analysis and team research. Year three leaves 30 EC open, then includes 6 EC each for project design and bioinformatics plus the required 18 EC bachelor project. No named comparator specialisation is selected.

The normal year-one plan contains 60 EC and exceeds the programme study-guidance page’s 42 EC binding-study-advice threshold. The Living Cell supplies the stated background for Cellular Responses. Data collection, R and experimental design precede Quantitative Biology, ecology/evolution team research and Big Data. Research Project Design and Planning prepares students to propose, conduct and report the final supervised individual project.

Recomputed the year totals from the 11 first-year and ten second-year components. Checked that the older cached PDF extract has an outdated credit distribution and that the dated PDF and current table agree on the regular curriculum. The 18 EC comparator project is independent and required. The 15 EC UCR research row is optional and excluded from totals.

The workbook gives population-dynamics calculations and modelling in R to Ecosystems Uncovered, explicit DNA and protein lab techniques to Life Science Laboratory, and gene regulation and signalling to Molecular Cell Biology. These support the specific positive alignments. The UCR options give meaningful coverage of biological methods at several scales while the dedicated botany and full animal-biology study remain gaps. Verified that remediation, epidemiology and numerical methods replace weaker or unschedulable content without distorting the options.
